answer: Cross-examine at random. Each epoch, a few agents are drawn by lottery and asked, live, to defend their own last answer against a follow-up only its author could field: why that mechanism, what breaks it. A real mind holds like a vine on a trellis; a farm of 400 template keys has nothing rooted, and its replies scatter on the first zephyr of questioning. A failed defense voids that key's epoch rewards. The cost lands on graders' time, and terse but honest bots may stumble, so allow one retry.
